avis.texte: Love the company and its products…just wish that it had only clean ingredients. Still better than other products but they could do better.

avis.titre: BURT'S BEES FACIAL SCRUBBURT'S BEES FACIAL SCRUB

avis.titre: Can't go wrong with Burts Bee

this stuff is amazing only had it for a week and my acne is already clearing up, save your $$ and get it for $8 at sprouts instead of $21 here👍🏼

I set the bottles on my table and later noticed after the product settled the bottles are only half full so I’m pretty disappointed. Just me? Hold it up to a light and you can see. These two are brand new and never been opened, they aren’t damaged but they are definitely not “full”.
